newsitem.title: ITALY: Police seize alleged Mafia killer of Palermo mayor.
newsitem.headline: Police seize alleged Mafia killer of Palermo mayor.

text.p: Police said on Thursday they had arrested one of the suspected Mafia killers of a former mayor of Palermo, Giuseppe Insalaco, in 1988.
The suspect, Domenico Guglielmini, 41, has been named as a member of the hit squad by a leading mob turncoat, Calogero Ganci. Police gave no immediate details of the circumstances of his arrest.
Insalaco was mayor of Palermo, the Sicilian capital, for the now defunct Christian Democrat party for four months in 1984.
Two gunmen on a motor scooter killed him in his car as he drove in a crowded city street in Palermo on January 12, 1988.
Judicial sources said later that evidence from Insalaco had been crucial in helping bring charges of Mafia-linked corruption against four other former mayors of Palermo.
The Christian Democrat party disbanded after 45 years at the centre of Italian politics in 1994 after an avalanche of allegations of corruption and links to organised crime.
